limitations: Synthetic-trained; not validated on BMW employee choices.
The basic logit model assumes independence of irrelevant alternatives.
Generated labels reflect latent fit, uniform utility noise, wait propensity and constrained supply, not a true logit process.
Deterministic fit normalization and expressed-demand mapping are assumed probability baselines, not calibrated acceptance.
Small or thin classes, missing attributes, censored outcomes and unseen ranges limit interpretation.
Observational points associations do not establish a causal response to a price nudge.

assumptions: Actual FUCQ-113 generator uses latent deterministic fit plus bounded uniform utility noise, not a logit data-generating process.
Waiting is an independent propensity or absent feasible stock; decline and expiry are separate censored outcomes.
Repeated cycles share fictional employee identities, with explicit supply depletion and release timing.
Synthetic assumptions demonstrate pipeline behaviour; no BMW employee calibration or causal price response is established.

learning.maximumGeneratedRecords.basis: Finite isolated engineering cap: 80 employees times four cycles, without changing canonical defaults.

learning.response.v1.basis: Illustrative noisy responses, expiry and independent allocation after acceptance; not measured employee behaviour.

comparison.accessGroups.basis: Illustrative access and response inequality models the dated release-rush question; group labels do not infer real jobs, devices or demographics.

comparison.briefNoise.v1.basis: Each stated preference and importance pair has an 80% chance of matching latent needs; otherwise choose another supported value where available. Essentials are preserved so noise cannot manufacture an unsafe relaxation.

comparison.buddyUptake.basis: Illustrative 75% consent uptake; remaining fictional employees can use the manual route in later stories.

comparison.carsPerEmployee.basis: Illustrative scarce supply deliberately permits unmet demand; rounded once for the whole cohort, never per person.

comparison.cohortSize.basis: Requested 1,000-person fictional comparison cohort, not a BMW workforce count.

comparison.configurationSet.v1.basis: Explicit temporary reviewed fixture set permitted by FUCQ-133; identity format follows existing Q13 policy, with fictional CMP/REF codes. No full scheme coverage or FUCQ-77 publication claim.

comparison.gradeDistribution.basis: Illustrative FS&UK grade mix using the canonical eligibility mapping. Monthly points resolve through getAllowance for each context, never copied here.

comparison.horizonDays.basis: Revisable 90-day comparison window; neither a BMW release commitment nor an employee renewal forecast.

comparison.importanceDistribution.basis: Independent illustrative importance weights, including indifference; preference value and importance remain separate.

comparison.maximumGeneratedRows.basis: Bounded synthetic materialisation limit rejects accidental excessive cohort/density requests before allocation; revisable application resource guard, not BMW policy.

comparison.modelLineMix.basis: Limited illustrative order mix over three reviewed structural fixtures. Not coverage of every scheme model line and not real stock-locator proportions.

comparison.needs.v1.basis: Illustrative registered essentials and preference values, with unmet needs allowed. These are synthetic latent needs, not recommendations or predetermined allocations.

comparison.pointsAllowanceMultiplier.basis: Baseline uses the canonical grade allowance unchanged; explicit what-if scaling is local to a generated comparison and never publishes policy.

comparison.releaseCadence.basis: Illustrative weekly 100-car releases from the synthetic origin. Monday and a real BMW operating schedule are not assumed.

comparison.renewalDays.basis: Uniform fictional renewal window inside the keyed horizon; no individual employee records are used.

comparison.seeds.basis: Three declared repeatable seeds expose variation without selecting a winning run; expand in the same source when needed.

comparison.startsAt.basis: Cycle zero begins at the pinned preparation instant so no generated choice predates feature provenance.

employee.recommendation.v1.basis: Read-only employee composition of existing rankCars curves; explicit dimensions, separate importance/indifference, confirmed exact evidence and no retail cash budget. Demo calibration is revisable, not BMW policy.

hold.buddy.durationSeconds.basis: Assumed new capability; roughly 2-hour proposal in demo brief/Q15.

stock.configuration.modelCodeField.basis: Assumed use of target knowledge-base format; AG/VG discrepancy remains open (Q13 round-3 and HLD).

choice.evaluation.v1.basis: Ten probability bands; flag groups under 20 choices; explicit numerical logarithm floor, with zero-probability events counted.
